# Lobs = integrate observed fluxes with no BB fit
# L+BB = observed flux + BB fit extrapolation
# See logL-obs_SN2021aatd_BgVri.txt and logL-bb_SN2021aatd_BgVri.txt for simple LC files
# Methodology:
# filters used:BgVri
# redshift used:0.01524
# extinction used:0.025
# Flux and wavelength converted to rest-frame
